description: This file defines a 'Notifications' class for the system console's site configuration notifications section, utilizing Playwright for UI testing. It includes locators and methods for interacting with notification settings in the Mattermost web application.

classes.name: Notifications
classes.description: Represents the notifications configuration section in the system console, providing locators and methods for UI testing.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes locators and settings for the notifications section based on the provided container.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Asserts that the notifications section and its header are visible.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Clicks the save button to apply notification settings.
